column2: 云盘管理可以连接云盘、浏览和传输文件，也可以把云盘上的目录挂载成 Windows 盘符。连接第一个云盘只要三步。
column3: Cloud management can connect to cloud drives, browse and transfer files, and mount a cloud folder as a Windows drive. Connecting your first drive takes three steps.
Do not show this guide again

column2: 点「新建端点」，在列表里选 Google Drive。
column3: Click "New endpoint" and pick Google Drive from the list.

column2: 点「创建」之后会打开浏览器，登录 Google 账号并允许访问。这一步由 Google 完成，Feng Sync 拿不到你的密码。
column3: After you click "Create" a browser opens: sign in to your Google account and grant access. Google does that step; Feng Sync never sees your password.
Come back and check the connection

column2: 回到这个窗口点「检查连接」。绿色的一行说明它已经连上；红色的一行会说明是哪一步没成。
column3: Back in this window, click "Check connection". A green line means it is connected; a red line says which step failed.

column2: 在右边直接浏览文件、拖拽上传下载；需要盘符的话，在左下角「挂载管理」里挂一个。
column3: Browse files on the right and drag them to upload or download; if you want a drive letter, mount one under "Mounts" at the bottom left.
